}}'''Careen''' is a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Careen}}

==Activities==
Careen was present after the fall of the [[Stone of Tear]], so presumably helped in the taking of it. She fetches [[Moiraine]] while [[Egwene]] and [[Nynaeve]] are questioning [[Darkfriend]] prisoners {{ref|[[Joiya Byir]] and [[Amico Nagoyin]]}} in order to [[Heal]] [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|4|3}}{{ref/book|4|6}}
